retention_policy: The repository carries 283 byte-for-byte text/source files and a complete metadata inventory for all 474 blobs. Fresh beyond1lte workspace preparation fetches the exact upstream commit with a filtered sparse Git checkout, verifies every path, size and Git blob SHA-1, then merges all 474 files (including the 191 non-text/prebuilt blobs) into the S10 target/platform trees. The OneROM postinstall.edify is preserved as reference only so the Artisan installer remains active; project-adapted upstream files and replaced Artisan files are retained with provenance. No binary payload is added to this repository.
